cards.title: Start an executable
cards.explanation: Group source files into packages and expose capitalized names. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Complete executable main package; no surrounding values.

cards.title: Import formatting and string helpers
cards.explanation: Import packages by path, optionally with a local alias. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt, strings. Package-level import block and function; add a package declaration.

cards.title: Track a count and readiness
cards.code:
count := 0
count += 2
var ready bool
ready = count > 0
cards.explanation: Declare typed or inferred variables; use := within functions. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: none. Inside a function; read ready in surrounding code.

cards.title: Define logging levels
cards.explanation: Define compile-time values, optionally in a repeated declaration group. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: none. Package or function scope; no surrounding values.

cards.title: Return a value or an error
cards.explanation: Declare named functions, parameters, and zero or more results. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Package-level function; callers handle the returned error.

cards.title: Build a stateful counter
cards.explanation: Use function values that capture variables, and accept a trailing variable argument list. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: none. Package-level factory; one returned counter is not safe for concurrent use.

cards.title: Check a collection before using it
cards.explanation: Branch on a Boolean expression, optionally with an initialization statement. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function with items []string.

cards.title: Repeat a fixed number of times
cards.explanation: Repeat with a three-part clause, a condition, or no condition. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function; no surrounding values.

cards.title: Visit a list with indexes
cards.explanation: Iterate over collections, strings, channels, integers, or iterator functions. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function; no surrounding values.

cards.title: Classify a response status
cards.code:
switch status {
case 200, 201:
    fmt.Println("success")
case 404:
    fmt.Println("missing")
default:
    fmt.Println("unexpected")
}
cards.explanation: Choose a matching case by value or by Boolean condition. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function with status int.

cards.title: Grow a list and copy it
cards.explanation: Use a variable-length view over an array. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: none. Inside a function; consume copyOfNames in surrounding code. This is a shallow copy.

cards.title: Take a view of a fixed array
cards.explanation: Use fixed-size values whose length is part of their type. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function; the slice shares array storage.

cards.title: Count entries and check a lookup
cards.explanation: Associate comparable keys with values. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function; the map is not safe for concurrent writes.

cards.title: Visit Unicode code points
cards.explanation: Represent immutable bytes as strings and Unicode code points as runes. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function; range offsets are byte indices.

cards.title: Modify a caller-owned value
cards.explanation: Refer to addressable values and dereference them. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: none. Package-level functions; increment requires a non-nil pointer and exclusive access.

cards.title: Construct a named record
cards.explanation: Group named fields into a value type. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: none. Package-level declarations; no surrounding values.

cards.title: Update a value through a method
cards.explanation: Attach behavior to a defined receiver type. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: none. Package-level declarations; do not use concurrently without synchronization.

cards.title: Accept any greeting implementation
cards.explanation: Describe behavior using method sets implemented implicitly. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Package-level declarations; caller supplies a non-nil Greeter implementation.

cards.title: Safely inspect an interface value
cards.explanation: Inspect the dynamic type held in an interface value. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt, strings. Inside a function with value any.

cards.title: Search a slice of comparable values
cards.explanation: Parameterize functions and types with constrained type parameters. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: none. Package-level generic function; no surrounding values.

cards.title: Read a file and preserve its error
cards.explanation: Report ordinary failures with an error result and test it explicitly. Go 1.22+. Imports: os and fmt. Declare readConfig at package scope; caller supplies a path. The whole file is loaded into memory; wrapped errors preserve the underlying cause.

cards.title: Close an opened file on return
cards.explanation: Schedule a call when the surrounding function returns. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: os. Inside a function returning error; input.txt must exist relative to its working directory. Read-only close errors are ignored.

cards.title: Contain a panic at a boundary
cards.explanation: Unwind a goroutine after an exceptional failure, optionally recovering in a deferred function. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Package-level function; work must be non-nil; recover handles only this goroutine.

cards.title: Wait for background work to finish
cards.explanation: Start a function call concurrently in the same address space. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function; waits for one worker to close done.

cards.title: Drain a buffered channel
cards.explanation: Communicate typed values between goroutines. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt. Inside a function; producer owns closure.

cards.title: Receive work or honor cancellation
cards.explanation: Wait on channel operations with optional non-blocking fallback. Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: fmt, context. Inside a function returning error with ctx context.Context and messages <-chan string. This minimal select does not distinguish channel closure or prioritize simultaneous cancellation.

cards.title: Table-test a validated port
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: testing, strconv, fmt. Place declarations in a *_test.go file in your package. Table cases assert value and rejection independently; the upper bound is a meaningful edge.

cards.title: Test file loading in an isolated directory
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: testing, os, path/filepath. Place this in *_test.go. TempDir owns cleanup; no user files are touched. Assert normal text, empty content and missing-file rejection.
keywords: test file loading in an isolated directory

cards.title: Benchmark joining a report
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: testing, strings. Place in *_test.go; the package variable keeps output observable. Run go test -bench BenchmarkReport -benchmem. Input setup is excluded; this measures joining, not I/O.

cards.title: Benchmark validated JSON decoding
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: testing, encoding/json. Place in *_test.go. Validate the result so a broken payload cannot silently become a successful benchmark. Allocation counts cover decoding, not payload setup.

cards.title: Decode one strict JSON configuration
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: encoding/json, strings, io, fmt. Package-level declarations; no other values required. Reject unknown fields, malformed/trailing input and invalid domain values. Duplicate JSON keys still use the later value.

cards.title: Encode finite metric values
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: encoding/json, math, fmt. Package-level function. Validate required name and finite numbers before serialization; JSON cannot represent NaN or infinity. Marshal escapes text safely.

cards.title: Reject invalid greeting requests
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: net/http, strings, fmt. Package-level HandlerFunc-compatible function. Requests are local; query decoding handles escaped names. Response write failures need a production logging policy.

cards.title: Test a health handler without a server
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: testing, net/http, net/http/httptest, io. Put in *_test.go. Recorder exercises status, body and headers in process; the empty GET body is valid. No sockets, TLS or middleware are tested.
keywords: test a health handler without a server

cards.title: Receive a job or return cancellation
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: context, fmt. Package-level function; caller owns channel closure and cancellation. Already canceled calls reject even when a job is ready. Concurrent arrival/cancellation can choose either ready case.
keywords: receive a job or return cancellation

cards.title: Validate work within a child deadline
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: context, time, fmt. Package-level helper; work must cooperate with the context. This does not forcibly interrupt work or convert an error to a timeout. Owner cancellation releases the child even on failure.
keywords: validate work within a child deadline

cards.title: Protect a shared counter with a mutex
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: sync, fmt. Package-level type and pointer methods; zero value is ready. Every read/write takes the mutex; never copy a used Counter. Bounded nonnegative totals must fit int.
keywords: protect a shared counter with a mutex

cards.title: Collect concurrent results with ownership
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: sync, fmt. Package-level function. Each worker owns one result index; caller reads after Wait. Caller must not mutate input concurrently. Intended for small batches, not unbounded production fan-out.

cards.title: Read nonempty lines and propagate scanner errors
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: os, bufio, strings. Package-level function. Path is supplied by caller; file is closed on success and scan failure. Uses Scanner default token limit and skips blank/whitespace-only lines. Close errors are ignored for this read-only file.
keywords: read nonempty lines and propagate scanner errors

cards.title: Write a report and check close errors
cards.explanation: Go 1.22+ (validated on 1.26.5). Imports: os, io. Package-level function; caller supplies a path whose parent exists. Truncates existing files, so use a disposable destination. Checks writes and close, but is not atomic replacement or durable fsync.
keywords: write a report and check close errors
